title: Imagine Sisyphus happy
idea: Camus pictured Sisyphus pushing his boulder forever and concluded that he could find meaning in the effort itself.
apply: Pick one repetitive task you dislike and find one thing in it you can do well or on purpose.
remind: Find meaning in the push, not only the summit.
who: Dee, who dreads the weekly report she must file.

scenes.nar: Every Friday, Dee pulls the same numbers, builds the same report, and sends it. Then she does it again next week.
To her it is pointless, a boulder rolled up and down. Dread starts every Thursday night.

scenes.cap: Camus: find the meaning in the push

items.x: Make it the cleanest report in the company
Time herself and beat last week
Add one useful insight each time

scenes.nar: Camus imagined Sisyphus happy. Dee cannot change the task, so she changes her relationship to it. She aims for a clean report, beats her time, and adds one insight.
A month later it takes twenty minutes, her manager quotes her insights, and the dread is gone. The meaning was in the push.
